## Download

**Nimbus-AppleSilicon.zip** (below, under Assets). For Macs with an M1 chip or later, macOS 14 or newer.

## Install

1. Double-click the zip, then drag **Nimbus** into your **Applications** folder.
2. Double-click Nimbus. macOS will say it can't verify the app. Click **Done**.
   (Nimbus is free and open source, but not registered with Apple yet.)
3. Open **Apple menu → System Settings → Privacy & Security**, scroll down, and click **Open Anyway** next to
   "Nimbus was blocked". Enter your password.
4. Double-click Nimbus again and click **Open**. You only do this once.

Nimbus has no Dock icon. Look for its icon at the top right of your menu bar, and move your mouse over the notch.

The zip also contains a **How to open Nimbus** note with the same steps.

Full details: https://github.com/harshavardanan/Nimbus#readme

Developed by [Harshavardanan](https://github.com/harshavardanan). Free and open source (MIT).
